headline.caveat: 'up to $10B' committed Nov 18, 2025; amount actually funded to date undisclosed

realized_to_date.caveat: funding schedule and amounts drawn never disclosed

nature_md: The other half of the Nov 18, 2025 three-way deal: NVIDIA commits **up to $10B** into Anthropic (Microsoft up to $5B) at a ~$350B valuation context, while Anthropic — historically a Trainium/TPU flagbearer — agrees to adopt NVIDIA architectures (Grace Blackwell, then Vera Rubin) for the $30B of Azure capacity and to deep technology co-design with NVIDIA. For NVIDIA this bought back architectural relevance at the one frontier lab that had built its scaling story on rival silicon; it also means NVIDIA holds equity in both OpenAI ($30B) and Anthropic simultaneously. Funded amounts are undisclosed — treat headline as ceiling, not flow.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: If/as funded: non-marketable equity investment at fair value, joining NVIDIA's >$40B 2026 ecosystem-equity program. The demand it secures (Anthropic's Azure capacity is NVIDIA-powered) returns as GPU revenue booked from Microsoft — investor and beneficiary at one remove.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity financing; no revenue. Strategic cost: dilutes Anthropic's silicon-diversification narrative — its three-cloud strategy now includes committed consumption of its investor's chips.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** NVIDIA now equity-seeds both leading labs — the two largest sources of GPU demand are partially funded by the GPU vendor, deepening the correlation Noah Smith concedes even in the bull case. **Bull:** ≤$10B against Anthropic's $350B→$965B valuation path was cheap optionality, third-party investors (Series H at $965B) priced the company far above NVIDIA's entry, and Anthropic's NVIDIA adoption reflects genuine multi-architecture demand, not charity.

events.title: NVIDIA commits up to $10B to Anthropic as it adopts NVIDIA architectures on Azure
